Preserved historical uncertainty replay

The earlier local statistical replay reproduced the saved cohorts and paired point estimates for 12 historical partitions. It evaluated 149,999 paired calendar-week bootstrap resamples and produced 336 exploratory adjusted intervals: 9 positive, 15 negative and 312 including zero. The 312 include 28 self-baseline controls; all 40 negative-control checks passed.

Competition / seasonPositiveNegativeIncludes zeroInterval rows

These are exposed 2024–25 and 2025–26 model comparisons with 22–23 calendar-week clusters. Positive means lower observed loss than the fixed model baseline, with exploratory percentile uncertainty; it does not establish market advantage or prospective superiority. The method does not remove repeated-team dependence, selection exposure or source drift, and does not guarantee exact finite-sample coverage. Current-season intervals with only 2–3 weeks and three-season weighted ranks remain withheld. No models were refitted and no new forecasts were issued. The paired table above retains its original recovered uncertainty labels; this is a separately dated aggregate supplement.
